entries.title: II Peter 1:1
segments: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained like precious faith with us through [the] righteousness of God and our Savior Jesus Christ,

entries.title: II Peter 1:2
segments: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

entries.title: II Peter 1:3
segments: according as His divine power has given to us all things that [pertain] to life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him who has called us to glory and virtue,

entries.title: II Peter 1:4
segments: through which He has given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, so that by these you might be partakers of [the] divine nature, having escaped the corruption [that is] in [the] world through lust.

entries.title: II Peter 1:5
segments: But also in this very thing, bringing in all diligence, filling out your faith with virtue, and with virtue, knowledge;

entries.title: II Peter 1:6
segments: and knowledge [with] self-control, and [with] self-control, patience, and [with] patience. godliness,

entries.title: II Peter 1:7
segments: and [with] godliness, brotherly kindness, and [with] brotherly kindness, love.

entries.title: II Peter 1:8
segments: For if these things are in you and abound, [you shall] not [be] idle nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: II Peter 1:9
segments: But he in whom these things [are] not present is blind and cannot see afar off and has forgotten that he was purged from his sins in times past.

entries.title: II Peter 1:10
segments: Therefore, brothers, rather be diligent to make your calling and election sure, for [if you] do these things, you shall never fall.

entries.title: II Peter 1:11
segments: For so an entrance shall be ministered to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

entries.title: II Peter 1:12
segments: Therefore I will not neglect to put you always in remembrance of these things, though [you] know [them] and are established in the present truth.

entries.title: II Peter 1:13
segments: But I think [it] right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by a reminder,

entries.title: II Peter 1:14
segments: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle is soon, as indeed our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

entries.title: II Peter 1:15
segments: And I will also be diligent to cause you to always have memory of these things after my departure.

entries.title: II Peter 1:16
segments: For not following cunningly devised fables, but becoming eyewitnesses of the majesty of Jesus Christ, we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord.

entries.title: II Peter 1:17
segments: For He received honor and glory from God [the] Father, when was borne to Him a voice from the excellent glory, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

entries.title: II Peter 1:18
segments: And we heard this voice being borne from Heaven, being with Him in the holy mountain.

entries.title: II Peter 1:19
segments: We also have a more sure word of prophecy, to which you do well to take heed, as to a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawns and the Daystar arises in your hearts,

entries.title: II Peter 1:20
segments: knowing this first, that no prophecy of the Scripture came into being of [its] own private interpretation.

entries.title: II Peter 1:21
segments: For prophecy was not borne at any time by [the] will of man, but holy men of God spoke being borne along by the Holy Spirit.
